ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels in the central region surrounded by a 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey perimeter boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central area contains a large contiguous white field. Dark pigmentation is concentrated along the entire trailing edge, terminal tips, and the peduncle insertion point. Scattered low-intensity linear streaks and localized dark clusters are present within the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55-65 degrees, extending deep into the peduncle midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged. Visible high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across both lobes. A prominent, deep macroscopic indentation (notch) is located on the outer third of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature from the median notch extending outward to the tips, characterized by a sharp upward taper at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single dark, circular high-contrast pixel cluster (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) located in the mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white central field on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss/notch on the upper outer perimeter of the left lobe; dense parallel linear scarring across the ventral surface consistent with macroscopic abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific intersection of a deep-set median notch and a secondary major notch on the left lateral lobe edge creates a unique geometric profile.
